outcomes.why: It is a page opening with kicker, headline and dek — the three-part first wall, not a single freestanding sentence like Statement.
Label plus big line plus one sentence of what follows is exactly the kicker/headline/dek opening of a page rather than a Timeline of dated entries.
A single sentence given the whole width with no label or evidence attached, unlike Observation which is a labelled watching paragraph.
One sentence at full width mid-piece; it asserts nothing that must answer to evidence, so it is not a Claim.
It is an assertion explicitly aware it must answer to evidence and may be wrong, not a neutral Observation.
A stated position marked as unproven — the defining posture of Claim rather than Evidence, which carries findings.
It watches a pattern without arguing a position or offering receipts, so Observation over Claim.
It is the question phrased as people ask it with a short quotable paragraph up front, which is Answer's job rather than Question's open-ended one.
The customer's own wording plus a lift-able answering paragraph is Answer; a Question would leave it unanswered.
Verbatim outside words with the trims marked is precisely Excerpt, not Snippet which is code or terminal output.
Someone else's prose typeset verbatim with source named and emphasis preserved — Excerpt rather than Snippet.
A command and its terminal output verbatim is the labelled code block, not prose Excerpt.
Raw JSON payload shown on the ink is code output, so Snippet over Excerpt's source-material framing.
Labelled findings with held/failed status marks and details are receipts, not the Claim they test.
Measured results with confirmed and contradicted status rows is Evidence rather than Agreement, which requires identical values.
Three independently-derived totals that must be identical with a FAIL condition is Agreement, not Evidence's mixed findings.
Three independent counts required to match exactly is the N-values-must-agree instrument, not a Comparison of two interpretations.
A level folded down a graded scale by successive caps and never asserted directly is Derivation, not Ladder's gated climb upward.
Start high and drop a level per flagged element, result derived from caps — Derivation rather than Gating.
First publication, last change and producing build are the publication record beneath the page, not a Citation to paste.
Commit, dataset version and sign-off date are the page's own publication record rather than a formatted reference.
A pasteable reference for someone else's paper is Citation; Provenance would merely display the record.
Copyable formats for bibliography software (BibTeX, CSL-JSON) is Citation's exact purpose.
A fail-closed outcome that must read as deliberate design rather than an error is Refusal.
A rule-based decline stating what was asked, what was available and the blocking rule is Refusal, not Gating's channel-by-channel judging.
An unresolved uncertainty printed openly rather than argued is Question, not Claim which takes a position.
An open question closing a chapter, given the dignity of an answer, is exactly Question rather than Connection's bridge outward.
Present variants of one identity plus a designed refusal for the absent one is Variants, which folds the Refusal in.
Three stocked cuts of one garment with a designed refusal for the discontinued fourth is the Variants pattern, not a bare Refusal.
An ordered, unskippable progression where each stage is closed by its own criterion is Ladder, not Procession's passive passage.
Phases gated by named endpoints climbed in order is Ladder rather than Procession, which has no gates.
A single artifact drawn as labelled layers with nothing hidden is Anatomy, not Decomposition's reader-stepped assembly.
A labelled section with every layer visible together and fully disclosed is Anatomy rather than the stepped Decomposition.
Whole, parts, and the assembling technique stepped by the reader is Decomposition, not Anatomy's all-at-once cutaway.
One object, its constituent parts and the assembling rule, advanced by the reader, is Decomposition rather than Unfolding's self-arriving parts.
Header fields drawn to scale so width equals byte width is ByteMap's literal definition, not Anatomy's annotated cutaway.
A physical layout where each region's drawn width is its true width is ByteMap rather than Anatomy.
One concept at several depths — explanation, object, clause — on one URL is Lens, not Comparison's two interpretations.
Same subject at chosen depths on one URL with the reader's depth remembered is Lens's remembered-depth behaviour.
A large mostly-dormant field where each input lights only the answering subset is ExpertField, not Gating's channel judging.
Hundreds of dormant specialists with each question waking a handful is exactly ExpertField's routing figure.
It widens one input into a broad candidate pool, judges and drops most, and brings survivors home — the widen/judge/return shape, not Compilation's stepwise merge of many distinct inputs.
Open intake, deliberately wide pool, most released, a narrowed set returned is the widen-judge-return stream; Ladder would require ordered rungs each with its own criterion.
A query surface with chrome as the form and one real executor behind it, rather than a passive Snippet of output.
Prompt plus scrollback plus results from the real index is the executor-backed query surface, not a static code block.
A chain of connected ideas replayed hop by hop with each link named is the path form; Procession would need one thing passing through stages rather than links between distinct items.
A labelled trail through connected ideas replayed in order is exactly the path-through-connections form rather than a dated Timeline.
One object under two interpretations with the reader dragging between them is Comparison; Transformation would perform the change rather than let the reader scrub.
Two readings of one product with reader-controlled movement between them, not a self-playing performance.
It performs the before/after change on arrival with identical props and explicitly refuses a dissolve-scrub, so it is the cinematic sibling, not Comparison.
Same props before and after, changing on its own when scrolled into view — performed rather than dragged.
Parts arrive on their own as the reader scrolls and then assemble, which is Decomposition's cinematic sibling rather than the hand-stepped instrument.
Components appear in sequence without being clicked, so it is the self-playing form, not Decomposition's manual stepping.
Many inputs compiled down through named stages into one output, losing separateness — Procession would keep one thing identifiable throughout.
A pile of raw responses reduced through named stages into a single figure is the many-into-one form, not one object travelling stages.
The same parcel survives every stage and is still itself at the end, which is passage rather than Compilation's merge.
One manuscript passing through ordered named stages, identity intact, rather than many inputs collapsing into one.
Explicit powers-of-ten steps rescaling the world at each arrival is Magnitude, not Procession's stage-passage.
An order-of-magnitude-at-a-time zoom-out where each arrival rescales the frame.
Fixed-capacity conduit where added pressure buys no throughput is the Channel performance, not Gating's judged-and-returned stream.
Fixed lines, flat throughput under rising demand, queue as the visible consequence — throughput through a capped conduit.
Rounding continuous colour to a coarse set and performing the loss itself is quantisation on a lattice, not a Comparison of two states.
Continuous data bucketed into a few levels, showing the bands and what falls between them, is quantisation performed rather than asserted.
A short filmed piece placed in the chapter flow with a poster until it earns the play is the Film form verbatim.
A recorded walkthrough living inside the article rather than on a video page is the in-flow film, not a performance built from props.
One sentence of why-it-follows plus the doors out is the chapter bridge, not a Statement standing alone.
A closing line explaining why, followed by the two onward links, is precisely the bridge-out form.
Dated entries in order as prose; Provenance would be publication-record metadata rather than narrative events.
Year-stamped entries in sequence — history as prose rather than a registered publication record.
A settled single sentence owed no evidence and given the whole width, unlike Claim which knows it must answer to evidence.
An assertion the page admits could be wrong and that must answer to evidence, not a settled Statement.
It reports what the recordings show and explicitly defers interpretation, so it watches rather than argues or asserts.
Independently derived values that must match, with a loud FAIL when they do not — the agreement instrument, not a Comparison of interpretations.
Rows of labelled findings with status marks, some confirming and some contradicting expectation, rather than a single Observation paragraph.
One document, two interpretations, the reader moving between them at their own speed — dragged, not performed.
Identical props performing the before/after change on arrival and settling on the after state, rather than reader-driven scrubbing.
One object, its parts, and reassembly stepped by hand at the reader's pace — the instrument, not the self-playing Unfolding.
The same parts arriving by themselves on scroll and ending assembled is the cinematic sibling of Decomposition.
The question phrased as customers ask it with one short lift-able paragraph beneath it, rather than an open Question left unanswered.
Someone else's words reproduced verbatim and typeset so the summary need not be trusted, not our own code Snippet.
A verbatim block of our own code shown on the ink, rather than third-party source material quoted as an Excerpt.
A deliberate, permitted-to-say-nothing withholding rendered as design language, explicitly not uncertainty, so not a Question.
Genuine unresolved uncertainty given full typographic dignity, unlike Refusal where the withholding is a choice rather than ignorance.
It asks for this document's own issue date, revision and version identifiers — the publication record beneath the page — rather than the dated history of the subject, which would be Timeline.
The dated succession of the policy area itself is history as prose, not the page's own publication record that Provenance covers.
Each stage is a gate that must be satisfied before the next may begin, which is a gated progression rather than Procession's simple passage through stages in order.
One identical object passing through every stage in order, with no gate closing each step, so it is Procession rather than Ladder.
One artifact drawn as its labelled regions all visible at once is an annotated cutaway, not a stepped assembly like Decomposition.
Drawn width equals width in bytes, including visible padding — the literal to-scale byte layout rather than a generic Anatomy cutaway.
A pasteable reference to the work is exactly the citation formats form, not the Provenance record of dates and versions.
One object under two interpretations with a drag control between them is Comparison; Transformation would be the cinematic performed sibling, and this asks for a control.
Physically present variants of one identity plus a designed absence for the one never produced is precisely Variants, not a two-way Comparison.
A fixed-capacity conduit whose throughput saturates is Channel; Derivation would be a value folded down by caps, not a capacity limit performed.
Successive thousand-fold rescalings until the small figure vanishes is the powers-of-ten zoom-out, not a staged Procession.
A pile of inputs reduced through named stages into something no longer any of them is Compilation, the inverse of Unfolding's parts arriving.
One concept at several depths — plain guide, tool, legal text — on a single address with remembered depth is Lens, not Comparison's two-way drag.
Kicker, headline and dek as the section's first wall is Hero; a bare Statement would be one sentence at full width without the naming line.
A stream widened into a deliberately wide working space, judged and mostly discarded, then brought back home is Gating rather than Compilation's named reduction stages.
A value that starts at maximum and is folded down by caps so it is never asserted is Derivation, not Ladder's ordered gates.
Labelled findings with their checks and sources are receipts, which is Evidence rather than a single asserted Claim.
It is a falsifiable assertion that must answer to evidence, not a neutral Observation that watches rather than argues.
The components arriving by themselves as the reader scrolls is the cinematic sibling of Decomposition, which would be stepped by hand.
The regulator's exact words typeset verbatim is Excerpt; Answer would be the question phrased as people ask it with an original answer beneath.
What the system will not do and why is fail-closed rendered as design language, not a general Observation about limits.
Dated approvals in order, with the ordering itself the point, is Timeline; Ladder would need each step gated by its own criterion in a live progression.
An answer with its supporting passage and a confidence score matches no vocabulary form — it is neither the Evidence receipts row nor Provenance's publication record.
Independently-derived totals that must be identical, with the mismatch surfaced, is Agreement's FAIL row rather than Evidence's findings.
One idea at increasing magnification — summary, mechanism, raw data — is depths of a single concept, not Decomposition's parts of an object.
Stages where two can reject outright are gates closed by their own criterion, unlike Procession's uninterrupted passage.
One sentence given the whole width at the top is Statement; Hero would add a kicker and dek around it.
One API shown as its constituent verbs laid out together is an object and its parts, not Anatomy's single artifact drawn as layers.
A transactional cart UI with steppers and totals is product interface, not any editorial or instrument form here.
A login form is application chrome with no counterpart in this vocabulary.
Grouped settings toggles are a preferences UI, not an instrument that argues or discloses.
A sortable paginated data grid is a generic table widget, not Evidence's labelled findings with status marks.
A constrained date picker is an input control with no vocabulary equivalent.
A transient success toast is notification chrome, and Refusal covers designed fail-closed states, not success feedback.
A three-tier pricing table is commercial UI; Variants concerns physically present variants of one identity, not purchase options.
A step-two-of-five progress bar is navigation feedback, not Ladder's criterion-gated rungs.
A clustering pin map is a geographic widget with no form in this vocabulary.
A live threaded chat with typing indicators is a messaging UI, not Terminal's single-executor query surface.
A draggable month calendar is a scheduling widget, not Timeline's dated entries as prose.
A drag-and-drop uploader with progress bars is file-input chrome with no counterpart here.
